14 Days | The Complete First-Timer's Journey

Sri Lanka Signature Experience Circuit

💰From $2,190🕐14 Days / 13 Nights📍11 destinations👥First-time visitors⚡Pace: Moderate📅Best: Nov – Apr

The definitive first-timer's journey through Sri Lanka — ancient kingdoms, legendary wildlife, mist-wrapped highlands, a scenic train ride, and sun-drenched beaches. Emil's Signature Circuit weaves the island's greatest experiences into a perfectly paced 14-day adventure, from the sacred city of Anuradhapura to the whale-rich waters of Mirissa.
